assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent, unexplained episodes of syncope and presyncope, raising concern for an underlying paroxysmal cardiac arrhythmia.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is performed with CPT code 93229.
The payer denied the claim under Reason Code CO-197.
Reason Code CO-197 indicates that the required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
The appeal requests retroactive authorization for the medically necessary diagnostic procedure.
